data.name: Logix Aurelia Commercial Developer License
includes: ability to submit products for Aurelia Compatible designation
published interfaces and affordable support/certification access for compatible cards, peripherals and monitors
third-party implementations may use licensed chips from AION or qualified independent suppliers
data.openness_policy: Basic published interfaces are accessible without mandatory certification. Developer fees cover the SDK, support and optional compatibility designation; competitors can implement compatible hardware and software. From COMDEX 1979, the separate manufacturer compatibility kit and optional support/testing services assist whole-computer implementations; the older developer registration is not a prerequisite.
